Title: Login has no success/failure handling
Description: Login doesn't navigate or show feedback on success/failure - UserCredential result is discarded
Priority Justification: Users can 'sign in' and see nothing happen; makes auth unusable

Title: No route guarding
Description: Every tab is reachable without being logged in - no redirect/auth check in the router
Priority Justification: Defeats the purpose of having auth at all

Title: Import path casing mismatch
Description: Imports reference 'Services/' but the actual folder is 'services/'
Priority Justification: Compiles on macOS's case-insensitive filesystem but will hard-fail on Linux CI/most build servers

Title: macOS uses a different Firebase project
Description: macOS Firebase project (goglyder) is a different project than Android/iOS/web (trydentlabs-goglyder)
Priority Justification: Desktop testing writes to a completely separate database; data silently won't match mobile

Title: Login is a nav tab instead of a gate
Description: Login is a bottom-nav destination instead of an entry gate, so users can navigate past it
Priority Justification: Confusing UX; users can access the app without ever logging in

Title: firebase.json output path mismatch
Description: firebase.json's dart output path (lib/firebase_options.dart) doesn't match actual file location (lib/services/firebase_options.dart)
Priority Justification: Next 'flutterfire configure' run will regenerate the file in the wrong place and break imports

Title: print() used for error logging
Description: print() used for error logging instead of a real logger/error handler
Priority Justification: Works today but gives no error visibility in production builds

Title: Firestore never read or written
Description: Firestore is initialized but never actually read from or written to anywhere in the app
Priority Justification: Nothing in the app persists; this blocks every other feature

Title: Calendar is fully hardcoded
Description: Calendar shows a hardcoded event list; the 'Carpool setup' button is a stub
Priority Justification: This is the headline pitch (calendar integration); currently 0% real

Title: Map has one hardcoded marker
Description: Map has one hardcoded school marker; 'Get Directions' and 'Share Location' are snackbar stubs
Priority Justification: This is where carpool matching would actually surface on a map

Title: Auth lacks verification/validation
Description: Auth service works against Firebase but sign-up has no email verification, password rules, or duplicate-account UX
Priority Justification: Functional but fragile - commit history literally warns not to spam sign-up because it may crash Firebase

Title: Community page is fully hardcoded
Description: Hardcoded groups/posts, 'Create post' stub, likes/comments don't persist
Priority Justification: Core to the 'community' pillar of the product pitch

Title: Messages page has no backend
Description: 955 lines of polished UI, fully in-memory, no real-time backend
Priority Justification: Largest single file in the app; biggest gap between UI polish and actual function

Title: Analytics dashboard uses fake data
Description: Renders hardcoded metrics (attendance, carpools/day, CO2 saved) instead of real data
Priority Justification: This is the 'prove ROI to the school' screen; buy-in depends on this being real eventually

Title: Homepage is static demo content
Description: Quick actions and 'upcoming' section don't reflect any real state
Priority Justification: Cosmetic until the features it links to are real

Title: Core data models + Firestore schema
Description: Define AppUser, School, Event, CarpoolTrip, Message, Post models and Firestore schema
Priority Justification: Everything else depends on this existing first

Title: School-scoping / multi-tenancy
Description: Every user and record belongs to a school; all data namespaced accordingly
Priority Justification: This is the sellable unit - without it there's one shared app instead of a per-school product

Title: Carpool posting & matching engine
Description: Parents post a trip, others request a seat, requests get accepted/declined
Priority Justification: The actual reason this app exists; currently doesn't exist in any form

Title: Safety layer: verification + emergency contacts
Description: Driver identity verification, emergency contact info, ride check-in/check-out
Priority Justification: This is a kids' carpooling app sold to schools; no school will buy without a liability/safety story

Title: Role-based accounts
Description: Parent, staff, and school-admin roles with different permissions
Priority Justification: Needed before a school admin can manage anything; prerequisite for school-scoping

Title: School admin dashboard
Description: Admin surface to manage events, invite families, view usage
Priority Justification: This is literally the product being pitched to the school as the buyer
column8: new: web or in-app admin surface

Title: External calendar integration
Description: Import school events from Google Calendar / iCal
Priority Justification: Explicitly promised in the product pitch; currently just a hardcoded list

Title: Real-time messaging via Firestore
Description: Replace in-memory chat with Firestore streams
Priority Justification: Depends on data models existing first

Title: Push notifications
Description: Notify on ride requests, new messages, event reminders
Priority Justification: Needed for the app to be useful outside active foreground use

Title: Driver ratings/trust system
Description: Post-trip rating system for drivers
Priority Justification: Reinforces the safety story; lower urgency than verification itself

Title: Real carbon savings calculator
Description: Feed analytics from real trip distances using Geolocator instead of demo numbers
Priority Justification: Ties the 'carbon efficiency' pitch to real numbers instead of fl_chart demo data

Title: Proximity-based carpool suggestions
Description: Suggest nearby families / similar schedules for matching
Priority Justification: Strong differentiator once basic matching works; not needed for v1

Title: District/multi-school billing
Description: Subscription management for multi-school/district customers
Priority Justification: Only matters once there are paying customers to expand within

Title: Offline support / local caching
Description: Local caching for spotty connectivity at school pickup zones
Priority Justification: Nice-to-have; not blocking for a pilot with one school

Title: No state management solution
Description: Everything uses setState plus a bare global router instance
Priority Justification: Will get painful fast once real async Firestore data flows in; better to switch now (Riverpod recommended) than mid-Phase-1

Title: No repository/service layer
Description: No abstraction layer between UI widgets and Firestore
Priority Justification: Without this every widget ends up with raw Firestore calls scattered through build() methods
File(s)/Location: new: lib/data/ or per-feature data/ layer

Title: No automated tests
Description: Zero unit, widget, or integration tests exist
Priority Justification: Fine for a solo-dev demo; risky once auth/payments/school data are real

Title: No Firestore security rules
Description: Nothing enforces school-scoping or role permissions at the database level
Priority Justification: Must land before real user data touches the database

Title: No dev/staging/prod Firebase separation
Description: Single Firebase project used for all environments
Priority Justification: Needed before onboarding a real pilot school so test data doesn't mix with theirs

Title: Global router.go() instead of context.go()
Description: Uses a global router instance instead of the BuildContext-scoped call
Priority Justification: Minor consistency issue

Title: Duplicated color constants
Description: darkGreen/lightGreen redefined independently in nearly every file instead of a shared theme
Priority Justification: Cosmetic consistency; easy cleanup whenever a file is already being touched

Title: README is still boilerplate
Description: README has no setup, architecture, or Firebase config instructions - still default Flutter template
Priority Justification: Matters once anyone else (or future you) needs to onboard

Title: No Firestore schema documentation
Description: No documentation of the data model / Firestore schema
Priority Justification: Should be written alongside the data models item above

Title: No architecture overview
Description: No note explaining the feature-first folder convention
Priority Justification: Helpful but not urgent
